# Gnimu frame reference encoder (vendored)

`frame_v1.h` and `layout_v1.h` are copied unchanged from [Gnimu-protocol](https://github.com/c20d-us/Gnimu-protocol) `include/gnimu_frame/`, at commit `5b40ae7`. Frame v1 is still in progress there.

Don't edit them here. To update, copy both files again from upstream and change the commit above. They're licensed Apache-2.0, as their headers say.
